name: dsh-musage-card
description: Local fork of dsh-musage: coding-plan quota and balance glass card for the DSH sidebar footer (above the mobile-access button). Remaining-percentage countdown bars (5h flowing green / 7d flowing rainbow). Tracks the selected model; API keys are reused from DSH model settings. Not published to any registry - installed via file: so the plugin market can never overwrite it.
